result.rationale: Pleuritic left chest pain in a 28-year-old after heavy chest workout, likely musculoskeletal, with no dyspnea, leg swelling, or smoking. Still, new chest pain warrants clinician review to exclude pneumothorax, pericarditis, or PE; no immediate red flags reported, but patient should escalate if shortness of breath, dizziness, or worsening pain develops.
